Container.Name: Kinboard
Container.Overview:
Kinboard is a self-hosted family dashboard, built for a touchscreen on the kitchen wall and every phone in the house. Calendars (Google, CalDAV and iCal), meals and recipes, shopping lists, tasks, chores and rewards, a photo screensaver, weather, and your smart home through Home Assistant, on one screen everyone in the family can use.
Everything stays on your own hardware. There is no account to create and no cloud service in between: the first device creates the family, and every other device joins it with the family's code.
Everything runs in this one container: the app, its PostgreSQL database and the scheduled jobs. Give it one folder for its data; back up that folder, and keep the backups private. go2rtc is not included: snapshot and MJPEG cameras work without it, and RTSP cameras need a separate go2rtc container (set GO2RTC_URL).
Push notifications, the barcode scanner's live camera and installing the app need an https address; everything else works over plain http on your network. Switch on "Use Tailscale" (Serve is preset) for an https address on your tailnet, reachable from your devices that run Tailscale; cloud AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude.ai) can't reach it. Other ways, and what each means, on the wiki's HTTPS page: https://github.com/svenger87/kinboard/wiki/HTTPS
Open the app and create your family; every other device joins with the family's code. The passwords and keys create themselves on the first start and are kept in the data folder.
Container.Requires: amd64 or arm64. Nothing else: PostgreSQL and PostgREST run inside the container. RTSP cameras need a separate go2rtc container.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: family calendar dashboard kiosk shopping list home assistant

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The port families open in a browser.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything Kinboard keeps: every family, calendar, list and setting; family photos, recipe pictures, vehicle images; the database password, the key that signs logins, the push keys. Back it up, and keep the backups private.

Config.Name: Backups (optional)
Config.Description: A folder on another disk for the automatic backups, for example /mnt/user/backups/kinboard on a share that is not on the data folder's disk. Empty keeps them in the data folder, which a failing disk takes with it. Each backup holds every family's data and keys: keep the folder private.
